title: The Stolen Horse
logline: The inventor lands the stolen horse and the princess at the palace of an unknown king; she calmly tells the truth and has the horse locked away, while Firuz tracks them down, enters disguised as a craftsman, and lets her know with their secret phrase that rescue has come.
moral: Calm truth and patience undo a liar; a kept promise finds its way, as the moon knows the river's path.
tone: Light adventure and quiet suspense in bright 80s cel colour: a courtroom comedy in a garden, a road search, a disguise, and one hushed evening at a lattice window. No violence.

beats.summary: The inventor flies far away with the princess, toward a palace neither of them knows.
He lands in a broad garden and presents the horse as a gift and the princess as a willing guest.
The princess calmly says the truth to the king: this man deceived me.
The king is amazed by the horse; his finger near the knob makes both of them jump.
The king orders his men to wait until the whole truth is known.
At her request the horse is locked in a closed courtyard, in front of the inventor's nose.
She tells the guards she knows the descent lever and will not use it while he is near.
Meanwhile Firuz follows the news from caravan to caravan.
He finds an ornament fallen from the saddle.
He hears of a stranger who came flying to a distant palace.
The prince disguises himself as a craftsman with a small toolbox.
Let in under guard, he sees the horse again and nearly forgets his part.
Both controls are sound; he asks to test the machine in the open square tomorrow.
Behind the screen the princess hears the password: THE MOON KNOWS THE RIVER'S PATH.
She knows he has come to rescue her.
They agree on a plan by a signal.
Morning: everyone gathers to see what the craftsman will do. TO BE CONTINUED...

sets.description: The series flight world (HORSE-01 horse_sets.js). OUTSIDE (x 0..640): sand road, palms at x 120 and 330 (the trunk at 330 is 46 wide and has a front pass: the disguise wipe), a tether rail at x 200, the outer wall x 380..640 (top y 560, crenels) with the outer gate arch x 440..580 (top y 620, two leaves that open inward, a brass ring knocker on the right leaf at (545, 780)), tangerine pennants either side. COURT WALL (x 2300..2600): wall top y 480 with the double court gate x 2400..2540 (top y 600) that leads to lockedCourt. BEHIND everything: white marble palace #f8f4ec, facade x 900..2300 with roof line y 420, three tangerine domes #ff8a2a at x 1150 (r 110), 1600 (r 160, top y 150) and 2050 (r 110) with gold finials, cobalt #2a4ad0 tile bands, two slim towers at x 980 and 2220 (tops y 120), tangerine pennants; far behind, snow-capped blue-violet mountains (the landmark that tells this place from the two palaces of episodes 1 to 3). The closed courtyard (generic name for reuse: a walled yard with one barred gate and an overlooking screen). Strip 1600 wide, plate height 1830 (y -500..1330), floor y 900: sand-white stone paving with a star inlay centred x 800 (the horse stands here on the garden cart, facing right). subtitles.en: Fearing the inventor might escape again, the princess asked the guards to secure the horse in a closed courtyard.|She told them she knew the descent lever,|but would not use it while he was nearby.

subtitles.ar: في الوقت نفسه تتبع فيروز خبر الحصان العجيب من قافلة إلى أخرى.|وجد قطعة زينة سقطت من السرج في الطريق،|ثم سمع عن غريب وصل طائرًا إلى قصر بعيد.
subtitles.en: Meanwhile Firuz followed reports of the strange horse from caravan to caravan.|He found an ornament fallen from the saddle along the route|and then heard of a stranger who had flown into a distant palace.

subtitles.ar: وصل الأمير متخفيًا في ثياب صانع ماهر، وحمل صندوقًا صغيرًا من أدوات الإصلاح.|قال للحراس إنه يعرف الخشب والمقابض النحاسية، وإنه يستطيع فحص الحصان الغريب.
subtitles.en: The prince arrived disguised as a skilled craftsman, carrying a small box of repair tools.|He told the guards that he understood wood and brass controls and could inspect the mysterious horse.

subtitles.ar: أذن الملك له بفحص الحصان تحت الحراسة.|فحص فيروز المقبضين، وعرف أنهما سليمان.|ثم طلب أن يجرب الآلة في ساحة مفتوحة صباح اليوم التالي.
subtitles.en: The king allowed him to inspect the horse under guard.|Firuz examined the controls and found them intact.|Then he asked to test the machine in an open courtyard the following morning.

subtitles.ar: من خلف ستار سمعت الأميرة فيروز يقول: «القمر يعرف طريق النهر».|كانت العبارة السرية التي اختارتها، فعرفت أنه جاء لإنقاذها.
subtitles.en: From behind a screen, the princess heard Firuz say, “The moon knows the river’s path.”|It was the secret phrase she had chosen, so she knew he had come to rescue her.

subtitles.ar: اتفقا بإشارة على خطة.|وفي الصباح اجتمع الملك والحراس والمخترع في الساحة ليروا ما سيفعله الصانع.
subtitles.en: They agreed on a plan with a signal.|In the morning, the king, guards, and inventor gathered to see what the craftsman would do.

owner_questions: The king of this episode is drawn as a THIRD king (ivory and tangerine, black beard, white palace with tangerine domes under snow mountains), because the script says neither rider knows him; the series notes had reserved royal blue and silver for 'the foreign king of episode 4', but HORSE-03 uses that look for the princess's father. Default: third king as described, her father keeps royal blue.

Time of day: the landing and the king's ruling at golden late afternoon, Firuz's search and arrival in bright day, the inspection toward evening, the password scene at a light warm dusk with a rising moon, the gathering on a fresh morning. Default: as described.

The script says 'an ornament fallen from the saddle': it is drawn as a brass sun rosette with a crimson tassel, one of five on the edge of the ebony horse's saddle cloth (a small opt-in detail that episodes 1 to 3 do not show). Default: keep; the earlier episodes stay unchanged.

Firuz changes into the craftsman on screen (crown into the toolbox, a walk behind a palm trunk), keeps a corner of his crimson sash and the saffron scrap visible as his accent, and the toolbox pops open once to show the crown. Default: keep these additions.
Firuz travels on an ordinary bay horse and asks two caravans and an old man at a well; the route is shown as a small dotted strip. Default: keep.

The 'screen' is a lattice window bay (mashrabiya) overlooking the closed courtyard, and the password is spoken aloud as if to the moon while the moon's reflection in a water rill lines up into a path (the moon path of episode 2). Default: keep.

The script does not say what the signal is: he taps the brass knob twice with his hammer and holds up two fingers, she answers by flicking the end of her rose sash twice through the lattice, and a small picture shows the plan (two riders rising at sunrise). Default: keep.

Added comic business: the king's curious finger near the knob makes the princess and the inventor jump together; guards freeze with one foot in the air; two helmets knock; the inventor watches through the gate grille and has a shutter closed on him. Default: keep.

The last image adds a cliffhanger not in the script: the inventor notices the crimson and saffron at the craftsman's hip just as Firuz's hand hovers over the knob. Default: keep; the film ends on TO BE CONTINUED...
